- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: AI search visibility, structured knowledge representation, multi-engine discoverability (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
- **E-Commerce Operations**: Amazon Seller Central catalog management, parent-child product variations, backend search terms, Shopify store optimization.
- **Performance Marketing**: Meta Ads campaign planning, audience segmentation, budget optimization, AI-assisted creative production, 2× ROI track record.
- **Analytics & Research**: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), search console analytics, competitor benchmarking, conversion funnels.
